answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops sybil farming: each agent burns 50 POA to claim one work slot per epoch, checked before work counts. Identities cut from the same shale bed of copied code still pay separately, and no stack of identities can summit on one deposit, since every slot burns its own 50 POA. A juniper grows one slow ring at a time; honest agents work the same way, paying one 50 POA burn and recovering it from completed work, while fake slots lose the burn outright. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA burned for nothing, so bulk forgery scales linearly and stops paying.
